[[24 BBY]] and [[22 BBY]] In [[Hyperspace Stories 6|''Hyperspace Stories'' 6]], a conversation between [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and [[Greedo]] reveals that Jabba had recently become a father to [[Rotta]], which occurs between [[24 BBY]] and [[22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:HyperspaceStories6Date|here]]. |death= |species=[[Hutt]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|rotta-the-huttlet|Rotta the Huttlet}} |pronouns=He/him |height=0.43 [[meter]]s {{C|1 [[Foot|ft]], 5 in}} {{C|child}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Orange]] |skin=Greyish-green |cyber= |families=[[Desilijic]] |parents=[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Jabba's criminal empire|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] {{C|informally}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The most gracious Jabba has one more small condition: he demands you bring back the slime who kidnapped his little…punky muffin.|TC-70, translating her master Jabba the Hutt|audio=PunkyMuffin-TCWf.flac|}} '''Rotta''', nicknamed "'''Pedunkee Mufkin'''" (translated as Punky Muffin) by his father and also nicknamed "'''Stinky'''" by [[Ahsoka Tano]], was a [[Gender|male]] [[Hutt]] and the son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], he was secretly kidnapped by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which was orchestrated by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] with help from [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]], Rotta's great-uncle. The plot was meant to discredit the [[Jedi Order]] and scuttle negotiations between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the Hutts, but the Jedi were able to rescue him. He was kidnapped by [[Asajj Ventress]] and taken to the planet [[Teth]]. A Jedi rescue team consisting of [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]] Ahsoka Tano traveled to Teth to rescue him. He then became sick and nearly died on his way to [[Tatooine]] but survived thanks to Ahsoka Tano. After Anakin Skywalker and Tano evaded Dooku, who tried to kill Rotta and blame the Jedi, Rotta was returned to his father. Rotta was later present when [[Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida]] visited [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]].{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} In [[20 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|420}} Ventress returned to Tatooine, and wished to avoid attention from Jabba as she had previously kidnapped his son.{{StoryCite|story=The Lost Nightsister|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} Rotta lived past the [[Imperial Era]] and into the [[New Republic Era]].{{SWYouTube|_pa1KLXuW0Y|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22, 2026}} {{Subtitles|YouTube}} ==Biography== ===Origins=== Rotta was born between [[24 BBY|24]] and [[22 BBY]]. Shortly after his birth, the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]] was attempting to make a reputation for himself and impress Rotta's father, Jabba the Hutt, by gifting him Billging Grubs, which he had accidently spilled on the floor after being grabbed by guards. Later on, Jabba and Greedo drank together, and the former mentioned that he had recently become a father.[[Hyperspace Stories 6|''Hyperspace Stories'' 6]] After some time, in another attempt to impress Jabba, Greedo brought a [[Wookiee]] that he had captured to him. After [[Bib Fortuna]] said that the prisoner was a toymaker named [[Brewhada]], Greedo stated that he had captured him so that he could become Rotta's personal toymaker. Jabba decided that Brewhada would become his son's personal toymaker. Later on, Greedo would narrate these events to Rotta, who fell asleep. At the same time, Brewhada was making toys for him, including a plush Wookiee. ===The Clone Wars=== ===Kidnapping and rescue=== {{Quote|Jabba requests that anyone who can help us find his kidnapped son send any information they have immediately|TC-70 to [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Sheev Palpatine|Palpatine]] and several [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Master|masters]]|}} [[File:Rotta-SWCT.png|thumb|left|200px|Rotta was friendly and happy.]] In 22 BBY, during the [[Clone Wars]], Rotta was kidnapped by [[Asajj Ventress]] while on a cruise aboard [[Jabba's sail barge]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro the Hutt]], Rotta's uncle, had helped the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] capture him in an attempt to start a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Hutt Clan]] so he could become the leader of the latter. Piloting a [[Trident-class assault ship]], Ventress destroyed one of the [[desert skiff|desert skiffs]] guarding the sail barge aboard which Rotta was located and used the tentacles of her ship to grab the vehicle. The remaining skiff returned to [[Jabba's Palace]] and a guard informed him of what had happened. Ventress took Rotta to the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on [[Teth]] where he was taken to a prison cell. Following the conclusion of the [[Battle of Christophsis]], [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Torrent Company]] went to Teth to rescue Rotta. The Republic wanted to free him so Jabba would agree to assist it in the fight against the Confederacy. As [[Low Altitude Assault Transport|Republic gunships]] carrying General Skywalker, Commander Tano, [[Captain]] [[Rex]] and the members of Torrent Company flew towards the monastery, the [[Battle Droid|battle droids]] guarding it began firing at them. Shortly after the gunships landed, the two Jedi and the clones began scaling the mountain atop which the monastery was located as the fight continued. After reaching the top of the mountain and destroying the droids, they went inside the monastery and encountered [[4-A7]], whom General Skywalker asked where Rotta was. He replied that the battle droids kept their prisoners on the detention level and the two Jedi went to find him. After they destroyed more droids, they reached the cell in which the [[Huttlet]] was being held. After they opened its door, they were surprised to see Rotta was a baby and Tano stated that that would make their mission to return him to his father a lot easier and that he was very cute. Skywalker replied that she should see what he would grow into. Shortly afterwards, she said that her Jedi training hadn't prepared her for this and asked him what they were going to do. He said that, since she thought the Huttlet was cute, she was going to carry him. [[File:4-A7recordstheJedi.png|thumb|right|250px|4A-7 records Skywalker and Tano as they place Rotta in a [[Grand Army of the Republic|GAR]] [[backpack]].]] As the two Jedi were exiting the monastery, Tano was holding Rotta in her arms and Skywalker asked her if she still thought Rotta was cute, to which she replied that the Huttlet was reminding her of him more and more. He said that she should carry them both then, before Rotta started coughing. The Padawan said that she thought he was sick and having a fever. Skywalker placed a hand on Rotta's forehead to check his temperature, agreeing afterwards that the Huttlet was ill and telling a [[clone trooper]] to bring him a [[backpack]]. As the two Jedi were trying to put Rotta in the backpack, he was screaming and struggling and Skywalker said that he hated Hutts. During this time, 4-A7 was recording what was happening so [[Count]] [[Dooku]] could use the footage to convince Jabba that they Jedi had kidnapped his son. A short while later, Skywalker and Tano were telling General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had convinced Jabba to join the Republic should it rescue his son and with whom they were talking via hologram, that Rotta had been kidnapped by the Separatists, and that he was sick. General Skywalker and General Kenobi knew that the Confederacy wanted to convince Jabba to join them by making it seem the Republic captured and murdered Rotta. As they continued talking, Separatist forces attacked them. Skywalker told Tano to get inside the building and she did so, carrying Rotta with her. As the battle continued, the Jedi Knight told the clone troopers to fall back and they all entered the monastery, locking the door. ===Escaping Teth=== {{Quote|He's a lot younger than I thought he'd be.''"
"''Oh,he's just a baby. This will make our job a lot easier. Oh, he's so cute.''"
"''Just wait until you see what he'll grow into.|[[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]] upon finding Rotta on [[Teth]]|}} General Skywalker, Commander Tano and [[R2-D2]] went to find an exit from the building, taking Rotta with them. They reached the throne room and noticed that Rotta was asleep. Skywalker told Tano to put down the backpack in which she was carrying the Huttlet and to get some rest herself. After they talked a short time, she did so. Ventress cut the lock of the door and the droids attacked the clones again as the battle continued. R2 found an outer landing platform and they were starting to go towards it, but General Skywalker noticed that Rotta was no longer in the backpack and asked Commander Tano where he was. She replied that he had told her to put him down and he told her to find him. They heard him grunting from under the throne and Skywalker grabbed him, telling him to come out of there as he pulled him from there, calling him a grubby little slug. As the Jedi Knight pulled him from beneath the throne, Rotta screamed. Shortly afterwards, the two Jedi and R2, along with the Huttlet, reached the outer lading platform and General Skywalker contacted General Kenobi, who had arrived at Teth with reinforcements. The Separatist forces were jamming their communications and two [[Droideka|Droidekas]] attacked them as Ventress came towards them. R2-D2 closed the door to the landing platform, locking the droidekas and Ventress inside the building. She began cutting through the door and the jedi wanted to head into the jungle, but [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid|spider droids]] began firing towards them from beneath the platform. Skywalker said that they were out of options and Rotta pointed towards an outer landing platform in the distance with a [[ship]] on it. Tano congratulated him for noticing the other platform and showing it to them and he smiled and waved his hand. Skywalker jumped on a [[Can-cell]] so it could them them to the ship and Tano fought Ventress. Skywalker directed the Can-cell towards Ventress and it hit her, sending her away from them. He grabbed Tano's hands and they flew away towards the platform and R2 did too, using his [[Rocket booster|rocket boosters]]. After they reached the second platform, they encountered 4-A7. Commander Tano was talking to him as General Skywalker put the backpack in which Rotta had been placed on R2's legs. They discovered that 4-A7 was a member of the Confederacy as a B1 battle droid exited the [[Twilight]] to tell him that they were ready to leave. Tano destroyed the droids there and cut 4-A7's head off. they entered the ship and, after trying to get it to work for a short time, they took off. Skywalker intended to help Rex and the other clones fight the droids, but Tano told him that Rotta was getting sicker and that they had to get him to the [[Medic|medics]] on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer]] in the atmosphere in order to save him. He agreed and started flying the [[freighter]] towards the cruiser. As they reached the [[cruiser]], they saw that a battle was talking place, as it was fighting against a [[Munificent-class star frigate]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] were fighting against [[Vulture-class starfighter|Vulutre droids]]. The crew of the Republic cruiser fired at the Twilgiht, thinking its an enemy ship and Rotta grunted as the ship was hit. At the same time, Vulture droids started firing at the freighter. Skywalker told the crew of the Venator his name and that they had to get the Huttlet to the medics on the cruiser. The Vulture Droids continued chasing the Twilghit and, as General Skywalker spun the ship so it could fly between the bridges of the Venator in order to fly away from the fighters, Rotta screamed and flailed his hand, being surprised by the maneuver. A [[clone navigation officer]] told General Skywalker that the crew thought they could lower the shields of the Venator on the lower rear hanger so the Twilight could land there. As he flew the ship toward the hangar, Commander Tano told Rotta that they made it and he was happy to hear that. Before they could land, the hangar was destroyed by vulture droids, so they decided to take the Twilight to [[Tattooine]]. As Rotta coughed, Tano caressed him and told Skywalker that she didn't think the Huttlet was going to survive and that there had to be something they could do for him. He told her to take a look in the back of the ship to see if there were any medical supplies there. ===Return to Tatooine=== {{Quote|How's Stinky holding up?''"
"''He seems to be feeling much better. His fever is gone. even you have to admit he's cute when he's asleep.''"
"''I admit I like him better when he's quiet, but only a little.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano talk about Rotta during the [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)|journey]] to [[Tatooine]]|}} [[File:AhsokaAttendsToRotto-TCWf.png|thumb|left|250px|Ahsoka Tano gave Rotta a medical booster, helping him get better.]] Tano asked the [[hologram]] of a [[Medical droid|medical droid]] if he had a remedy for Rotta's condition and he indicated a medical booster to her and told her to dispense it into the Huttlet's mouth. Rotta refused to take it at first, but did so shortly afterwards, then burped and laughed. She then put him back in the backpack which she laid on a bunk bed. as she caressed him, she told Skywalker that Rotta's fever had broken and that she thought he would survive. A short time after the Twilight exited hyperspace near Tattooine and they talked a little, Skywalker asked Tano how Rotta was feeling and she replied that he seemed to be much better and that his fever was gone. She then said that he had to admit Rotta was cute while he was asleep and he replied that he admitted he liked him better when he was quiet, but only a little. Soon after that, they were attacked by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard|MagnaGuards]] flying [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter|Rogue-class starifghters]]. Rotta was asleep for a while, but, during a maneuver taken to avoid fire from the fighters, he fell in Tano's arms and woke up, crying. General Skywalker and R2-D2 destroyed the fighters, but the Twilight had been shot and was crashing towards the planet. After the ship crash-landed, they were about to start walking towards Jabba's palace and Rotta cried because he wanted Tano to come with them and she smiled at him, telling him she would. [[File:Ahsoka vs MagnaGuards.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka protected Rotta from the MagnaGuards attempting to kill him.]] Later on, Skywalker decided they should split up in order to get Rotta to his father. Tano took him and Skywalker took the backpack, which had been filled with rocks, to make Count Dooku think he was the one carrying Rotta. Skywalker dueled Dooku while Tano fought Magnaguards. Both Jedi won the fights and Skywalker arrived at Jabba's palace and, after Tano did too, she handed Rotta to his father. Jabba wanted his guards to kill the Jedi, but Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] contacted him from [[Ziro's Palace]], after having discovered that he had helped the Separatists kidnap Rotta and after she, along with [[Commander]] [[Fox]] and members of the [[Coruscant Guard]], had captured him. Ziro told Jabba that Count Dooku captured Rotta, but Jabba knew that Ziro had helped in the capture. He decided to join the Republic. ===Kidnapping of Chairman Papanoida's daughters=== A year later, in [[21 BBY]], when [[Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida]] and his son, [[Ion Papanoida|Ion]], came to Jabba's palace in order to find Greedo, who had kidnapped the chairman's daughters, Rotta saw a butterfly and hit it several times. Jabba told him to stop and he grabbed the butterfly, eating it and smiling. ===New Republic Era=== By the [[New Republic Era]], Rotta had grown large and muscular, and was present in an arena yelling out to a crowd as [[Din Djarin]] watched{{SWYouTube|_pa1KLXuW0Y|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22, 2026}} before engaging in battle with him.{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}} ==Personality and traits== As a Huttlett, Rotta was 0.43 [[meter]]s (1 [[foot]], 5 inches) tall,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' with [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s and greyish-green skin. Rotta was very intelligent and perceptive, understanding what was happening around him and what people told him and coming up with a solution to the issue of being stuck on the back door landing platform of the B'omarr Monastery by noticing the Twilight and the platform it was on and showing it to General Skywalker and Commander Tano. He was cheerful and friendly and developed a close friendship with Ahsoka Tano. He was also strong both mentally and physically, able to survive his sickness and heal and to still be cheerful, friendly and to show the two Jedi the location of the Twilight. His physical strength was also evident when he killed a butterfly with his fist. Rotta cared about Tano and his father, crying because he wanted Tano to join him and Skywalker when they were leaving for Jabba's Palace and being happy to see his father. He liked playing and having fun, moving under the throne in the B'omarr Monstery and eating the butterfly he had killed. By the New Republic era, Rotta had grown in size and became muscular. ==Skills and abilities== Rotta had strong family connections, such as his father Jabba. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== Rotta appears in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], where he was vocalized by [[David Acord]]. Per Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]]'s initial series concept, Rotta was intended to be a character in the series alongside his father, Jabba. The concept was later developed into the theatrical film.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' Rotta's part in the story of ''The Clone Wars'' film and him being carried by Anakin on his back were inspired by the [[1989]] Samurai movie [[Wikipedia:Shogun's Shadow|''Shogun's Shadow'']].{{WebCite|url=https://thewookieegunner.com/2018/09/08/star-wars-animation-panels-highlights-dragon-con/#more-17162|text=Highlights of the 'Star Wars' Animation Panels at Dragon Con 2018|date=2018-09-08|work=TWG|nobackup=1}} Rotta will make his live-action debut in the [[2026]] film [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu|''The Mandalorian and Grogu'']], voiced by [[Jeremy Allen White]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-2|text=Pedro Pascal Stars in New Trailer for ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''}} White was offered the role by director [[Jon Favreau]] after talking with him about movies. He provided his initial voice work before the beginning of filming and only realized while doing them, the importance of his role in the franchise. After the filming, White had to return to do more voicing and in October [[2025]], said that he assumed that he would have to do some more lines in the near future.{{YouTube|video=-FS9Rnur0zc|text=Jeremy Allen White played Bruce Springsteen...while he was on set|channel=c/gma|name=Good Morning America|date=2025-10-14}} ===Continuity=== In [[Hyperspace Stories 6|''Hyperspace Stories'' 6]], it is revealed that Rotta was recently born. A [[doll]] with a bow is seen being made by [[Brewhada]], which means it is set before [[Hyperspace Stories 1|''Hyperspace Stories'' 1]], where the very same doll appears. The events of ''Hyperspace Stories'' 1 occur before the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], where Rotta is portrayed as visibly smaller and younger than in ''Hyperspace Stories'' 6. As such, it is assumed that ''Hyperspace Stories'' 6 was merely mistaken in its larger depiction of Rotta. In a [[StarWars.com|Star Wars.com]] blog post, Rotta is described to be 55 years old during the events of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film.{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-rewatch-theatrical-release-3-of-3|text=''The Clone Wars'' Rewatch: A Sith Plot Unravels in the Theatrical Release (Part 3 of 3)}} This article gives precedent to
